Entries.Text: Enable Viewport Movement
Hold this button to move in the viewport.
Select Map Object
Press this button to select a map object in the viewport.
Interact with Gizmo
Press this button to use a gizmo control.
Start Box Drag
Press this button to start a box selection.
End Box Drag
Release this button to end a box selection.
Display Viewport Context Menu
Press this button to open the viewport context menu.
Select Map in World Map
Press this button to pick the maps under the cursor in the Map Information window's World Map mode, to load with Selected Tiles.
Start World Map Drag
Press this button to start dragging the world map.
End World Map Drag
Release this button to stop dragging the world map.
Paint Map Information
Hold this button to paint, fill or pick with the current tool in the Map Information Editor.
Pick Map Information Value
Press this button to pick the value under the cursor as the paint value in the Map Information Editor, whatever the tool.
Pan Map Information
Hold this button to drag the map in the Map Information Editor.
